subject: How do I change my logo?
body: Hi, how do I change the logo on my website? I have a new PNG ready. Thanks, Priya Sharma

subject: Favicon size
body: How to update the favicon and what size should it be? Ours looks blurry.

subject: Refund process question
body: How do I refund a member payment from last week? Where do I click?

subject: Adding search filters
body: How can I add category and location filters to member search? Is custom code needed?

subject: Create membership plan
body: How do I create a membership plan with a free trial for new members?

subject: Edit order confirmation email
body: Where do I edit the order confirmation email template? I'd like to change the wording.

subject: Import members CSV
body: How to import about 2,000 members from a CSV? What columns do I need?

subject: Change contact email
body: How do I change the contact email shown in the footer of our site?

subject: Send password reset link
body: A member forgot her password. How can I send her a password reset link?

subject: Connect Stripe
body: How do I connect Stripe so we can start taking payments?

subject: Export member list
body: How can I export my member list including plan and signup date?

subject: Mobile menu
body: How does the mobile menu work, and can I change where the search bar sits on phones?

subject: Payments failing since yesterday
body: Our member payments keep failing since yesterday. Nothing changed on our side. Please help urgently.

subject: Emails going to spam
body: Order confirmation emails are landing in spam for most customers. What do we check?

subject: Member locked out
body: A member says she can't log in and her account seems locked after a few tries.

subject: Logo not updating
body: I uploaded a new logo yesterday but the old one still shows on the homepage. The upload itself didn't give an error.

subject: Import skipping rows
body: Our CSV import stopped importing some rows and skipped about 300 members. Why?

subject: Test mode charges
body: A test charge worked but real cards fail. The gateway shows an error about currency.

subject: Reset link expired
body: Members say the password reset link expires before they can use it. Is 60 minutes normal?

subject: Search shows no results
body: Member search returns no results even for members who definitely exist. It stopped working this week.

subject: Notification emails not sending
body: Welcome emails are not working for new signups since Monday. Templates look switched on.

subject: Refund button missing
body: I can't find the Refund option for a transaction from 7 months ago. Is there a time limit?

subject: New booking feature
body: Can you build a booking calendar so members can take appointments directly on their profile?

subject: Custom search ranking
body: We need a custom search that ranks premium members higher and understands typos. Can you develop this?

subject: Mobile app enquiry
body: We want a mobile app version of our directory for members. Where do we start?

subject: Add reviews feature
body: Can you add a feature for verified reviews with photos on member pages?

subject: Multi-language site
body: We need a version of the site in Spanish and French. Is that a setting or custom development?

subject: CRM integration
body: We need a integration that pushes new member signups into our CRM automatically.

subject: Please cancel and refund
body: Please cancel my plan and refund this month's payment. We are closing the business.

subject: Charged twice
body: I was charged twice this month. Please refund the duplicate charge immediately.

subject: Cancel subscription
body: I want to cancel my subscription. Do I keep access until the end of the period I paid for?

subject: Refund for unused plan
body: I never used the plan I bought 3 weeks ago. Can I get my money back?

subject: Close my account
body: Close my account completely and stop all future charges please.

subject: Chargeback warning
body: If the refund is not processed this week I will raise a chargeback with my bank.

subject: Your update broke our site
body: Your latest update broke our homepage layout. This is unacceptable during our peak season.

subject: Very disappointed with support
body: I am very disappointed — three days and no proper answer about our broken payments page.

subject: Frustrated and considering leaving
body: Honestly frustrated. Search has been broken since the update and our members are complaining to us.

subject: Formal complaint
body: This is a formal complaint about downtime last Friday. We lost bookings and want an explanation.

subject: Terrible experience
body: Terrible experience so far. Half the features I was sold don't seem to work as described.

subject: Legal escalation
body: If this billing issue is not resolved, our lawyer will be in touch. The service has been unacceptable.

subject: Quote for custom filters
body: How much would it cost to add advanced filters (price range, rating) to our search?

subject: Price for migration
body: Can you give me a quote for migrating 4,000 members from our old platform?

subject: Cost to redesign homepage
body: What would be the cost to redesign our homepage and member profile pages?

subject: Pricing for payment gateway
body: We need pricing for integrating a local payment gateway that isn't Stripe or PayPal.

subject: Estimate for booking system
body: Please share an estimate for building the booking system we discussed — ballpark is fine.

subject: Following up on refund ticket
body: Following up on my refund request from last week — any update?

subject: Did you receive my email?
body: Did you receive my previous email about the logo issue? Still waiting to hear back.

subject: Any update on search fix?
body: Any update on the search problem I reported on Tuesday? Our members keep asking.

subject: Still waiting for quote
body: Still waiting for the quote for the homepage redesign. Can you chase it please?

subject: Follow up: import help
body: Just a follow up — we're ready to do the member import whenever your team can guide us.
